r2ah/93-cognito-explicit-client-bindings.template.yaml:
Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31
Resources:
  Staff:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
  StaffClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      UserPoolId:
        Ref: Staff
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
      - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
      - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
  Customers:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
  CustomersClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      UserPoolId:
        Ref: Customers
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
      - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
      - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
  LoginFunction:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: nodejs22.x
      CodeUri: .
      Handler: handler.handler
      Environment:
        Variables:
          STAFF_CLIENT_ID:
            Ref: StaffClient
          AUTH_CLIENT_ID:
            Ref: CustomersClient
      Events:
        Login:
          Type: HttpApi
          Properties:
            Path: /login/{realm}
            Method: POST
